route: conditional isolated adapter; reference-only until qualification
rationale: Existing registry, results, errors and replay metadata are valuable. Preserve scientific semantics in a stricter consumer contract and supervise actual runtime mode.

alternatives.reason: Uniform transport schema and metadata do not establish estimator-specific target, covariance, diagnostics or rights.
Pinned worker with typed consumer contract avoids replacing mature estimators; retain errors, provenance, actual execution mode and complete risk details.
A scientifically necessary kernel or deployment constraint may justify a bounded port; broad copying adds solver, dependency and maintenance burden.
Source-grounded design comparison and independent witnesses are available without claiming execution.

alternatives.decision: reject blanket certification and unsafe result promotion
alternatives.reason: Schema acceptance or upstream certified labels cannot justify truth, all-method parity or automatically retrying a still-running call.

scope_limits: Static primary-source review and project-authored schema/arithmetic witnesses only; no downloaded package code executed.
No native integration, full dependency rights clearance, scientific calibration, visual acceptance or bank adoption.
Cutoff revision is distinct from the published paper archive; eleven files are not a whole-repository audit.
